newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 482.50/483.50/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 482.50/483.50/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat in moderate trade at 482.50/483.50 per dollar even as the Central Bank supplied the market with only modest dollar sales, traders said.
"The Central Bank is continuing with its tactic of supplying just a few drops of dollars, here and there," said one trader.
Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between intervention and supplying liquidity.
Traders added they saw little interest by foreign investors in the weekly Central Bank auction of TEMs as "at the price they were selling, investors were not interested."
Yields on six month paper edged ahead 32 basis points to 17.80 percent in the 100 billion bolivar auction even as they fell slightly at the longer end of the curve.
